subject: OpenFrame maintainer support + demo passes (credits & logistics)
messages:
From: Leo Tanaka <leo@openframe.dev>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya@hackhub.org>
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Maintainer credits + demo passes for OpenFrame Hackday (May 22-23)

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks for taking a look — I'm Leo, community lead at OpenFrame. We're organizing a two-day community hackday on May 22-23 focused on low-latency audio processing and web integrations. A number of our core maintainers (listed in the attached CSV) are unpaid volunteers and we'd like Redwood to provide support in two ways:

- A pool of compute/credit support for maintainers to run short prototypes (asking for 150k token-equivalent credits, split across ~8 maintainers).
- 40 demo passes to distribute to maintainers & selected workshop mentors so they can run live demos against Redwood-hosted models without hitting rate limits.

We have a sponsorship from CloudSponsor for venue and travel; this ask is specifically for product/credits and demo passes. Budget and event overview attached (OpenFrame-hackday-proposal.pdf).

Event page: https://openframe.dev/hackday-may22

Two quick questions up front: can Redwood issue promo/demo passes that bypass rate limits for scheduled demo windows? And would you be open to a short trial extension for the maintainers (we often onboard new contributors during the event and might need an extra 30 days of trial time)?

Happy to hop on a 20-min call if that's easier.

Thanks,
Leo
Community Lead, OpenFrame
---
Attachment: OpenFrame-hackday-proposal.pdf (application; 3 pages)
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Leo Tanaka <leo@openframe.dev>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2026 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Maintainer credits + demo passes for OpenFrame Hackday (May 22-23)

Hi Leo — thanks for the application and the clear event overview. Really appreciate the context on CloudSponsor covering venue.

We can absolutely support maintainers for community hackdays; couple of clarifying items so we scope this right:

1) Credits: when you say "150k token-equivalent", is that across the entire cohort or per maintainer? If cohort-level, do you want us to pre-provision per-email or share a single grant pool?
2) Demo passes: do you need demo passes to be time-limited (e.g., two 90-minute windows each day) or full-event access? We typically issue time-limited promo sessions to avoid SLO impact.
3) Trial extension: we can evaluate a 30–90 day extension for the maintainer emails you provide; we'd prefer a 60-day default for onboarding windows, but open to 30 if it's sensitive.

If you can reply with the CSV of maintainer emails + a preferred demo pass scheduling window I can route this through Partnerships and Community Ops for the allocation. Looping in Marissa for sponsor coordination and Rishi & Soojin for credit ops and maintainer program alignment.

Best,
Evelyn
Community Programs Manager
Redwood Inference
---
Attachment: (none)
From: Leo Tanaka <leo@openframe.dev>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya@hackhub.org>
Date: Mon, 13 Apr 2026 08:06:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Maintainer credits + demo passes for OpenFrame Hackday (May 22-23)

Hey Evelyn — thanks for the quick reply. Attached is the maintainers list with emails and GitHub handles (maintainers-list.csv).

Answers:
- 150k token-equivalent is cohort-level; splitting automatically is fine, but we'd prefer per-email pre-provisioning so each maintainer can demo independently.
- Demo passes: two scheduled windows (Day 1: 2:00–3:30pm PT; Day 2: 11:00am–12:30pm PT). If Redwood can enable higher concurrency for those windows that would be ideal.
- Trial extension: 60 days would be perfect.

We can provide a short blurb for event marketing if helpful. Small ask from CloudSponsor: could any logo/exposure be mirrored in the event slides listing Redwood as "community platform sponsor"?

Thanks again — attaching maintainers-list.csv.

Cheers,
Leo
---
Attachment: maintainers-list.csv (8 rows)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Apr 2026 09:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Proposed allocation: OpenFrame hackday (maintainer credits + demo passes)

Team — putting a proposed allocation on the thread so we can finalize before EOD:

Proposal (subject to approvals):
- 160,000 token credits total (slightly above ask to cover warmups) pre-provisioned to each maintainer email (8 emails) at 20,000 tokens/account.
- Demo passes: 50 time-bound demo passes configured as 2x90-minute elevated-concurrency windows (Day 1: 14:00–15:30 PT; Day 2: 11:00–12:30 PT). Assign to maintainer emails + 10 mentor passes for CloudSponsor mentors.
- Trial extension: 60-day trial extension applied to the 8 maintainer accounts.

Next steps: legal/finance need a short SOW note (one-pager) and a line-item in the community grants ledger. I've drafted an allocation sheet (attached) and a short draft SOW; if legal signs off we can issue a DocuSign grant letter next week.

Questions for Leo: are the maintainer emails company-managed or personal? We prefer company-managed addresses when possible for auditability; if personal emails are necessary we will require consent to TOS changes for trial accounts. Also confirm whether Redwood's logo can appear on slides (OpenFrame asked).

Attachment: allocation-sheet.xlsx (redwood internal allocation spreadsheet)

Marissa
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Leo Tanaka <leo@openframe.dev>, Priya Singh <priya@hackhub.org>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Apr 2026 15:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Maintainer credits + demo passes for OpenFrame Hackday (May 22-23)

Thanks all — happy to confirm the proposal from Partnerships. Quick summary:

- Redwood will provision 160k tokens split across the 8 maintainer emails (20k each).
- We will issue 50 demo passes scoped to the two scheduled windows.
- Trial extension of 60 days applied to the listed maintainer accounts.

Leo — could you confirm in reply whether the maintainer emails are personal or org-managed? Once confirmed we'll generate a short SOW and send a DocuSign grant letter (HS-23456) for signature. If it's org-managed we can expedite the onboarding; if personal we will include consent text in the grant.

Also: happy to be listed as a community platform sponsor on slides — thank you. I'll follow up with the DocuSign link and a one-paragraph blurb for marketing.

Best,
Evelyn
Community Programs Manager
Redwood Inference
